transcript.answer: Lore's own Floor engine (`apps/floor`) was deleted on 2026-10-02 (PR #2431, spec external-floor FR16). It was about 17,500 lines and 113 test files. The external Floor replaced it. That is the rewritten standalone engine in re-cinq/floor, which runs in the same cluster. Lore reaches it only through `@re-cinq/floor-client`, as set out in ADR-049. The code-review family of lines moved first, and the other lines moved one family at a time. The deletion also removed the old Floor's Helm subchart, its build workflow, and the five ticks only it answered. A migration (0095) removed its bus subscription.
